name: ghosted
description: Cuts Claude Code costs: frees context when you switch task, can compact long runs mid-run and carry on, terse terminal answers, and recall of archived work.

max_context.title: Compact mid-run at (tokens)
max_context.description: During a long run, compact when the context reaches this many tokens (for example 250000), then continue where it left off. 0 = off (the default; in tests it cost more on single long runs). Values under 100000 count as 100000.

switch_min_tokens.title: Check for a new task above (tokens)
switch_min_tokens.description: Only ask the judge whether a prompt starts a new task when the conversation since the last compaction is at least this big.

terse.title: Terse answers
terse.description: Shorter text in the terminal. auto (default): full, but off when caveman is already active, since stacked style rules cost more. full: compressed notes. lite: no filler. off.
